text: Practice any art, music, singing, dancing, acting, drawing, painting, sculpting, poetry, fiction, essays, reportage, no matter how well or badly, not to get money and fame, but to experience becoming, to find out what's inside you, to make your soul grow.
author: Kurt Vonnegut

text: Some believe it is only great power that can hold evil in check, but that is not what I have found. It is the small everyday deeds of ordinary folk that keep the darkness at bay. Small acts of kindness and love.
author: Gandalf the Grey

text: Happiness can be found, even in the darkest of times, if one only remembers to turn on the light.
author: Dumbledore

text: The Force will be with you. Always.
author: Obi-Wan Kenobi

text: It does not do to dwell on dreams and forget to live.
author: Dumbledore

text: All we have to decide is what to do with the time that is given us.
author: Gandalf the Grey

text: Do or do not. There is no try.
author: Yoda

text: It is our choices that show what we truly are, far more than our abilities.
author: Dumbledore

text: Even the smallest person can change the course of the future.
author: Galadriel

text: We are what we pretend to be, so we must be careful about what we pretend to be.
author: Kurt Vonnegut

text: In my experience, there is no such thing as luck.
author: Obi-Wan Kenobi

text: Not all those who wander are lost.
author: J.R.R. Tolkien

text: There is some good in this world, and it's worth fighting for.
author: Samwise Gamgee

author: Uncle Ben

text: Life moves pretty fast. If you don't stop and look around once in a while, you could miss it.

author: Oscar Wilde
